newsitem.title: UK: TABLE-Celsis losses narrow by 33 pct in yr.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Celsis losses narrow by 33 pct in yr.

text.p: NOTE - Turnover for continuing operations in 1996/97 was 8.3 million stg versus 5.1 million. An exceptional charge of 1.44 million stg relates to the reorganisation following the acquisition of Lumac -- the market leader in the food, drink and dairy end-product screening market.

"Celsis has made excellent progress this year and is steadily moving towards profitability," chief executive Arthur Holden said. "Our alliance partnerships are performing ahead of expectations and, having integrated Lumac and launched a number of significant profits this year, we look forward to significant sales growth and reaching profitability in the year ahead".
Full name of microbial detection group - Celsis International Plc.
